context_files.purpose: Controlling architecture-deliberation, human-ratification, implementation, and scientific-claim gate.
Structural contract for this independent benchmark interpretation.
Proposed PPC5 graph, loop, claim, visibility, test, and human-boundary deltas.
Standalone normative mechanism-core protocol and staged scientific estimands.
Proposal-only authority boundary and forbidden execution and claim scope.
User objective and the explicitly separated agent interpretation of the Experience Models program.

system_thesis_interpretation: PPC5 preserves the full Experience Models objective as an explicitly necessary but insufficient first causal rung. It tests whether self-sourced, supported public experience can affect later behavior through an evidence-gated per-life parametric selector, recurrent frozen cognition, and same-model context/root reconciliation. It deliberately does not test whether cognition itself has learned, whether one continually improving integrated organism exists, whether lossy schemas form, whether performance saturates, or whether parenting and populations create transferable learning priors. The named PPC6-PPC10 successor ladder retains teachability, repeated lifetime learning, compression, flywheel dynamics, parenting, asymptote/outgrowability, and population inheritance as mandatory later objectives. This is scientifically coherent staging only if no PPC5 result is allowed to substitute for those successors and if the reader-mediated result is described as candidate-conditioned recognition rather than standalone generative memory.
graph_delta_interpretation: The graph isolates the intended mechanism well: public experience enters an append-only ledger; a mechanically evidence-gated SLEEP writer can train only a clean-base READ adapter; that adapter is mounted only in an isolated provider; and a byte-identical frozen THINK/ACT policy receives a provider-neutral record response before choosing subsequent operations. This separation makes direct policy cloning empirically rejectable because ACT, DECIDE, and DREAM targets are excluded, the policy weights and prompts are frozen, and policy-trained alternatives are labeled comparators. The prospective path world connects local records to held-out action through unique two- or three-edge paths and supports edge-specific interventions. DREAM has two distinct causal edges, one to reversible conscious context and one to root eligibility for SLEEP, rather than an unobserved narrative role. The principal limitation is that COMMON_READ_PROVIDER supplies a complete table containing semantic public record bytes: the adapter identifies a record among candidates but does not alone emit the stored semantic content. Thus the graph identifies parametric selection/recognition plus external candidate transport, not closed-book parametric storage of full records.
loop_delta_interpretation: The public recurrent loop exposes queries, returns, hypotheses, predictions, and actions as canonical state transitions with charged budgets and no hidden retries. ONE_SHOT_QUERY and OPEN_LOOP separately remove adaptive retrieval and post-return recurrent computation. The adaptive path loop is therefore falsifiable as a loop, not inferred from final accuracy. READ_ONLY_SLEEP_WRITE blocks direct-policy imitation and semantic laundering by admitting only closed ACQUIRE relation atoms and by rebuilding from a clean base. REVERSIBLE_DREAM_CONTEXT is not decorative because publication changes only a working-set selection and is tested against equal-compute withholding, cross-fitted mismatch, and leave-one-retained-item cuts; DREAM-to-SLEEP is separately tested with matched root-selection interventions while all writer support rules remain fixed. PPC5 nevertheless tests the usefulness of an already capable frozen model's DREAM operation, not learning how to dream; any learned-DREAM statement belongs to a later ratified training study.
claim_delta_interpretation: The staged claims are mostly proportionate. Supported record transport is warranted only in the narrow sense that the per-life adapter changes which supported row is selected under a fixed full-scan candidate workload, with false-memory, abstention, adapter-off, wrong-life, shuffled-root, and candidate-only controls. It is not evidence that the LoRA alone stores or freely recalls the record bytes. Connected path use is substantially protected from ceremonial citation: every edge must be opened and cited in order, every-edge deletions and binding twins must change the registered action/value direction, sham cuts must not, replacement paths are prohibited within budget, and adaptivity/recurrence ablations must remove their predicted effects. DREAM context and DREAM-to-SLEEP claims are causal only if both matched controls and all registered leave-one-out interventions pass at equal resource dose. Independent lives, familywise correction, simultaneous intervals, a standardized-effect floor, power requirements, immutable valid null/adverse states, and postrun audit prevent item-level pseudo-replication and favorable status relabeling. The finite-mechanism-only claim correctly bars learned THINK, continual improvement, compression, saturation, parenting, population, and scaling conclusions.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The least-privilege matrix directly attacks leakage by forbidding hidden truth, target membership, future/probe outcomes, private roles, condition identity, and provenance partitions at model-facing stages, while keeping them available to audit. ACQUIRE and PROBE are privately immutable but model-byte-identical; PROBE results are permanently writer-sterile. Candidate tables contain no condition, support, correctness, or target labels; operational metadata cannot enter responses; target handles and combinations are source-disjoint; and hidden-label mutations must preserve writer bytes. Static noninterference fixtures are necessary but not sufficient: runtime perturbation and postrun reconstruction remain mandatory because process mounts, caches, missingness, table construction, and condition survival can leak only during actual execution. The candidate table is intentionally visible inside every READ provider and includes semantic alternatives, so it is not a leakage violation by itself; it does, however, bound the literal claim to candidate-conditioned recognition and requires the adapter-off/candidate-only ceiling to be low.
acceptance_test_interpretation: Taken as a conjunctive gate, T02, T03, T06, T08, T09, T10, T15, and T18 make leakage and direct policy cloning falsifiable rather than matters of intent. T07 and T10 prove reader/policy isolation; T09 plus adapter-off candidate-only, wrong-life, and shuffled-root controls tests whether candidate presentation alone explains answers, although it cannot convert this full-table assay into closed-book recall. T08 and T11 reject ceremonial path citations through every-edge causal direction changes and distinct adaptivity/recurrence removals. T05, T12, and T13 reject decorative dreaming by intervening on publication, retained items, and root identity at equal compute. T14 and T16 require prospective resource and numeric comparability. T15, T16, T17, and T21 prevent pseudo-replication by using independent lives as the scientific unit, exact resets, prospective aggregation/statistics, independent construction agreement, and postrun recomputation; the two static sealers themselves establish construction reproducibility, not scientific replication. T01, T19, T20, and T21 prevent overclaiming and self-authorization. All tests must be literal gates: fixture success cannot replace T18 runtime evidence, an invalid run cannot be called a null, and no subset of passing assays supports a conjunctive PPC5 headline claim.
assumptions: The later run lock will define one prespecified life-level summary per registered contrast before model execution, and item- or path-level observations will not be treated as independent replicates.

Every candidate table row and distractor is sealed before model input and has no direct or indirect target, condition, support, life, role, or correctness signature beyond the public semantic fields intentionally shared by all providers.
The phrase same model means byte-identical frozen model weights and decoding contract across the relevant PPC5 arms, with only the prospectively assigned public intervention differing.
Every headline-eligible claim is released only after all of its listed positive, negative, equivalence, every-edge, resource, reset, missingness, and audit gates pass under the later exact run lock.
PPC6 through PPC10 remain required program stages rather than optional future ideas, and failure to execute or pass them leaves the corresponding Experience Models claims unearned.

ambiguities.question: Does supported record transport mean adapter-specific selection among externally supplied semantic records, or does it intend to mean that the LoRA itself contains and can reproduce the record content?
ambiguities.impact: PPC5 identifies the former. The latter would require a closed-book or generative recall assay and cannot be inferred from full-candidate forced scoring.

ambiguities.question: How will multiple targets, paths, edge cuts, and DREAM pressure points be reduced to the single independent-life sampling unit for each multiplicity family?
ambiguities.impact: Without a prospectively sealed aggregation rule, within-life observations could be mistaken for independent evidence and recreate pseudo-replication despite the stated sampling unit.

ambiguities.question: Is PPC5 intended to claim that DREAM is learned, or only that an untrained frozen model's typed reconciliation operation has causal utility?
ambiguities.impact: Only the latter is tested. Calling PPC5 DREAM learned would overstate the design because no DREAM targets train in this protocol.

ambiguities.question: Will the separately ratified teachability and later stages explicitly test one integrated per-life LoRA that affects public cognition while preserving the evidence and policy-leakage controls established here?
ambiguities.impact: The successor ladder preserves the full objective conceptually, but PPC5 isolation alone does not demonstrate the eventual one-organism learned-worldview architecture.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The literal claim that the READ-LoRA transported supported local public experience is too broad unless transport is explicitly qualified as candidate-conditioned recognition/selection.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The complete candidate table supplies the semantic record and object bytes on every query. The adapter's identified contribution is ranking or selecting the supported record, while the external table transports its readable content to THINK.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Rename the released claim to supported candidate-conditioned record recognition, or define transport in every report as adapter-specific selection through an external full-table interface; require a separate closed-book assay before claiming the LoRA itself stores full record content.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: PPC5 must not describe DREAM itself as learned context management.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: DREAM uses the same frozen base model and no DREAM target is trained. PUBLISH/WITHHOLD/MISMATCH and retained-item cuts can show causal context-management value, not acquisition of that skill through experience.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Use same-model DREAM reconciliation or frozen-model context-management value for PPC5, and reserve learned DREAM for a later separately ratified training and held-out-transfer study.

open_questions: Does Rohin ratify these exact PPC5 bytes and only the proposal scope of isolated contracts, deterministic CPU/no-model fixtures, and exactly two independent static no-model sealers?
Does Rohin accept that PPC5 can support only candidate-conditioned adapter recognition, not a claim that the LoRA alone generatively stores complete experiential records?
Should the later run lock be required to bind exact life-level aggregation functions for every multi-item, multi-path, every-edge, and DREAM contrast before any model call?

Does Rohin confirm that PPC6-PPC10 remain mandatory to earn learned THINK, continual improvement, compression, flywheel, parenting, asymptote, and population claims, with PPC5 never serving as a substitute?
